source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-38

procedures.title: Condenser: replace
steps: Purge the refrigerant from the system.
Scribe the hinge locations, then take the hood off.
Raise the headlamps and remove the headlamp actuator assemblies.
Remove the outer center screw of the receiver-dehydrator bracket.
Disconnect the receiver-dehydrator outlet fitting and the condenser inlet hose clamp; cap or tape both openings right away.
Remove the screws holding the condenser to the radiator support and lift out the condenser together with the receiver-dehydrator.
Install in reverse order, using a new O-ring coated with clean refrigeration oil on the receiver-dehydrator outlet line; torque that connection to 13 ft. lbs.
Evacuate, charge and check the system, adding 1 fluid oz. of refrigeration oil for a new condenser.
notes: See figure 43 in the manual (Corvette condenser).
